notes: Definition migration records availability contracts, not successful acquisition, installation or execution.
A new worker005 candidate family; this record does not increase the qualified coverage of the baseline 1862 resources.
A material cpgpkg contains source/vendor or local NuGet feed. No external SDK is embedded and installation performs no dependency resolution.
Functional checks require the exact external SDK named by CPG_RUST_SDK_ROOT. Protected recipe manifests bind all executable/library/reference files before running the material payload.
Rust also needs a compatible host C linker; the reference host uses GCC. .NET requires compatible libc/libstdc++/ICU/OpenSSL and consistent PID/proc visibility.
Every functional check starts an empty dependency cache and a fresh build under the operation directory. Source prefixes remain unchanged.
Offline behavior is implemented through frozen Cargo/vendor and local-only locked NuGet. The runner does not create an operating-system network namespace or claim packet tracing.
The prepared upstream source references are provenance. Cargo archives are provided in extracted vendored form with checksums; original NuGet archives are embedded.
